facts.fact: 四名罪犯扑向她（她把刀刺进他们的喉咙与心脏）
facts.anchor: the four criminals who’d flung themselves at her

facts.fact: 她只添了两处割伤与几道擦伤
facts.anchor: She was lucky she’d only gained two cuts and a few scratches

facts.fact: Winter 拒认她赢：要再办一场、须独自赢
facts.anchor: We’ll have another game and you’ll need to win. On your own

facts.fact: 他用下一场游戏压下 Micah 的要求
facts.anchor: She’ll entertain us with another game soon

facts.fact: 她杀惯狼，从未杀过同类
facts.anchor: never had she killed her own kind

facts.fact: 她石砸一名女人、刺死一名绊倒她的男人
facts.anchor: The woman she’d stoned to death, the man she stabbed after he’d tripped her

facts.fact: 她倒地后被他抱起上楼
facts.anchor: Winter’s strong arms lifted her, pressing her against his firm chest

facts.fact: 他母亲非贵族出身、教他自理伤口
facts.anchor: My mother wasn’t born royalty. She taught me how to take care of my own wounds

facts.fact: 承诺赢下场可见弟弟、表现好还给纸
facts.anchor: I’ll even give him the paper he asked for

facts.fact: 提 Talia 时他眼里只有怒没有痛
facts.anchor: Pain wasn’t in his eyes, only rage swirling in their depths

facts.fact: 她裹毛巾出来，他目光变暗
facts.anchor: His gaze darkened and hungrily swept down her body
